+@pytest.mark.parametrize("qt_version, expected", [

+def test_extra_suffixes_workaround_versions(monkeypatch, qt_version, expected):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(qtutils, "qVersion", lambda: qt_version)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(mimetypes, "guess_all_extensions",
+                        lambda mime: [".jpg", ".jpe"])
+
+    assert webview.extra_suffixes_workaround(["image/jpeg"]) == expected
+
+
+def test_extra_suffixes_workaround_specific(monkeypatch):
+    extensions = {
+        "image/jpeg": [".jpg", ".jpe"],
+        "image/png": [".png"],
+        "video/mp4": [".m4v", ".mpg4"],
+    }
+    monkeypatch.setattr(qtutils, "qVersion", lambda: "6.5.2")
+    monkeypatch.setattr(mimetypes, "guess_all_extensions",
+                        lambda mime: extensions[mime])
+
+    assert webview.extra_suffixes_workaround(
+        ["image/jpeg", "video/mp4"]) == {".jpg", ".jpe", ".m4v", ".mpg4"}
+    assert webview.extra_suffixes_workaround(
+        ["image/jpeg", ".jpg", ".jpe"]) == set()
+    assert webview.extra_suffixes_workaround([".jpg"]) == set()
+
+
+def test_extra_suffixes_workaround_wildcard(monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(qtutils, "qVersion", lambda: "6.5.2")
+    monkeypatch.setattr(mimetypes, "types_map", {
+        ".jpg": "image/jpeg",
+        ".jpe": "image/jpeg",
+        ".png": "image/png",
+        ".mp4": "video/mp4",
+    })
+
+    assert webview.extra_suffixes_workaround(
+        ["image/*", ".jpg"]) == {".jpe", ".png"}
+
+
+def test_choose_files_adds_missing_suffixes(monkeypatch, config_stub):
+    class TestPage(webview.WebEnginePage):
+        def __init__(self):
+            QWebEnginePage.__init__(self)
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(qtutils, "qVersion", lambda: "6.5.2")
+    monkeypatch.setattr(mimetypes, "guess_all_extensions",
+                        lambda mime: [".jpg", ".jpe"])
+    received = []
+
+    def choose_files(self, mode, old_files, accepted_types):
+        received.extend(accepted_types)
+        return []
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(QWebEnginePage, "chooseFiles", choose_files)
+    page = TestPage()
+    mode = QWebEnginePage.FileSelectionMode.FileSelectOpen
+    page.chooseFiles(mode, [], iter(["image/jpeg", ".jpg"]))
+
+    assert received == ["image/jpeg", ".jpg", ".jpe"]
